name: @polymarket-bot-test/soak-recorder
description: WP-140 recorder soak harness: runs the real data-gateway bundle for a bounded window (loopback-only by default), writes machine-readable evidence records with first-class duration, and evaluates them fail-closed — a soak is PENDING until real elapsed evidence meets the threshold.
